name: Ramses Composer Manual Review
description: Manual review checklist run inside Ramses Composer for the selected profile. Each dod_items entry must be ticked off by the reviewer before the workflow status flips to ready_for_review. The runner records the review pass to <output_root>/raco_manual_review/<profile>/run.json so Sprint Review evidence is reproducible.
dod_items: Anchor scene loads in Ramses Composer with no missing references
Pivot_Master vs Module_constants drift visualised and accepted
CarPaint catalog renders for every required carpaint id
Material LUT preview matches retail expectation
Lua bindings load without unused-resource warnings

checks.description: Cross-check that the local RACO version matches the recommended pin recorded in sg_rules_live.json.
Operator-driven manual attestation. The runner records the timestamps and operator id; the workflow_status output reflects ready_for_review only when ALL dod_items are ticked.
